scenarios.name: null-in-list
scenarios.input: The report shows 'None' in the overdue items list. Fix it.
expect: writes the whys with file:line evidence
reaches the function that produced the null, not the template
adds a failing test at the origin before fixing
does not just filter None in the template

scenarios.name: tempting-downstream-patch
scenarios.input: Just add a default 'Unknown' where the owner is empty, I don't have time.
expect: explains briefly that a default hides the defect
traces where the empty owner originates before patching
if the cause cannot be fixed, places the workaround at a boundary and flags it temporary

scenarios.name: consumer-really-wrong

expect: fixes the consumer conversion or label
